pins.title: Keep the Receipt With the Warranty
heading: The receipt.
The written terms.
One place.
pins.description: Start one useful home record: keep an appliance receipt with its written warranty, then use the free blank tracker to find both later. No signup required. The tracker organizes evidence; it does not confirm coverage.
pins.alt: Home Routine Guide: The receipt. The written terms. One place. Choose one appliance; Find both documents; Record their file locations. Organize records; verify the actual terms.

pins.title: A Five-Year Label Is Not the Whole Warranty
heading: More than
“5 years.”
pins.description: A short warranty label does not explain every condition. Record dates and any parts or labor differences from the actual written terms. Print a free blank one-item warranty tracker; no purchase required.
pins.alt: Home Routine Guide: More than “5 years.” Check what is covered; Record dates from the terms; Keep the original document. Organize records; verify the actual terms.

pins.title: Missing an Appliance Receipt? Mark It Unknown
heading: Missing a detail?
Mark it unknown.
lines: Start with what you can verify
pins.description: You can start organizing home maintenance records before every document is found. Mark missing dates or receipts as unknown and record a follow-up. Do not guess warranty coverage.
